title: fonderie.download: every font gets its own world
note: Each typeface page is designed around the font rather than a shared template: Beast sits in a retro terminal box bordered with its own A glyph, Garamon(d/t) is white text on a jagged black blob with a white circle punched through it, Quarantype is scattered #typedesignathome stickers, Zara is a big sentence with a type tester under it. What holds it together: black and white, crop marks in the corners, a fixed nav of square icon buttons (one glyph from each font, plus an eye for fonts in use and a ? for about) and the round download button bottom right. Worth reusing: keep the frame (nav, marks, one button) strict so each page can go wild inside it.
